tools.name: noren_gateway_stats
tools.description: Live gateway statistics: how many paid APIs, 402 challenges, and settled USDG payments on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663), read from the gateway.

tools.name: noren_list_apis
tools.description: List the pay-per-call APIs the gateway sells, with their path and price in USDG. Use a slug from this list with noren_pay_call.

tools.name: noren_reputation
tools.description: Reputation of an EVM wallet computed only from payments that settled on Robinhood Chain: score, tier, settled count, total USDG and the transaction hashes behind it.

tools.name: noren_leaderboard
tools.description: Top paying wallets by settled count, from the gateway leaderboard.

tools.name: noren_verify_payment
tools.description: Check a payment on Robinhood Chain directly from the chain RPC: whether the transaction succeeded and the USDG Transfer events it contains. Does not trust the gateway.

tools.name: noren_pay_call
tools.description: Call one paid gateway API and pay for it in USDG over x402 on Robinhood Chain. The price comes from the gateway list, never from arguments. Requires NOREN_PAYER_KEY in the client environment, a per-call cap (NOREN_MAX_USDG_PER_CALL) and a daily cap (NOREN_MAX_USDG_PER_DAY). Returns the API result and the settlement transaction.
